newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore defence chief leaves for U.S. visit.
newsitem.headline: Singapore defence chief leaves for U.S. visit.

text.p: Singapore's Chief of Defence Force, Lieutenant General Bey Soo Khiang, left for a 12-day visit to the United States on Saturday at the invitation of U.S. Chairman of the Joint Chiefs of Staff, General John Shalikashvili.
Lt-Gen Bey will call on U.S. defence chiefs, Pentagon officials and tour various military facilities Singapore's Ministry of Defence said in a statement.
Lt-Gen Bey will also visit the Republic of Singapore Air Force (RSAF) Chinook helicopter training detachment in Texas and an RSAF F-16 fighter detachment in Arizona.
The visit "serves to underscore the strong defence ties between the United States and Singapore," said the statement.
